root_cause_verification.rationale: Root cause commit cfc5766 introduced _parse_shopping_brands as a workaround for missing schema support. This fix adds the missing schema support (brands property on shopping_item) and updates the generator to use structured data when available. The regex parser is preserved for backward compat but is no longer the primary path. All three layers (schema, agent prompt, generator) updated consistently.
